layman_headline: Solana is up 5.3% and running strong — no reason to jump ship or chase new trades yet.
layman_explanation: Our Solana position is performing well, already up over 5% from where we bought it. The broader crypto market is in a 'Greed' mood, Bitcoin is pushing toward $80K, and Solana is one of the strongest large-cap performers this week with an 18% weekly gain. The swing trade candidates on our watchlist are either stablecoins (no opportunity), already overextended (PUMP at RSI 84, LIT up 29%), or lack enough technical data to justify a confident entry.
layman_action: Hold your current Solana position and consider raising your stop-loss to $97 to lock in some gains. Wait for a pullback or clearer setup before adding a new position.
expert_reasoning: SOL is up 18% on the week and 4.47% in 24h, approaching our $115 exit target. The position is in profit at +5.3% with a well-defined trade plan. The candidate list is extremely weak: PUMP has an RSI of 84 (deeply overbought), LIT is up 29% with no technical data to establish support levels, MON is in a downtrend, and three candidates are stablecoins. BTC dominance at 59.2% is headwind for alts, but SOL is bucking this trend due to ecosystem-specific catalysts including the disinflation vote. Raising the stop from $92 to $97 protects ~breakeven while giving the trade room to reach the $115 target. With Fear & Greed at 73 and rising, the market could get overheated soon — another reason to manage the existing trade rather than add exposure.
risk_factors: SOL has moved 18% in a week and could face sharp mean reversion if BTC pulls back from $80K
BTC dominance at 59.2% continues to suppress alt performance broadly — SOL is an outlier that may not persist
Fear & Greed at 73 and trending higher suggests we're approaching euphoric territory where corrections become more likely
watch_list: Fed Chair Warsh's Jackson Hole speech — could trigger major risk-on or risk-off move across crypto
SOL price action near $110-115 resistance zone — watch for volume exhaustion or rejection
BTC behavior around $80K — a decisive break above could fuel further alt rally, rejection could trigger broad selloff
market_context: The crypto market is in a greed-driven rally with BTC near $80K and select alts like SOL and ZEC outperforming significantly. Warsh's Jackson Hole speech is the key macro event that could either extend or reverse the current momentum.
context_banner: SOL trade is on track toward its $115 target — discipline and patience beat chasing in an overheated market.

Warsh's Jackson Hole speech flagged as a 'major event for bitcoin and gold' — key macro risk that could swing prices either direction within 48 hours.
